The '''Burgrave of Sedava''' was Duke of Ledostrov during the 1938 famine crisis.

== Famine Crisis ==

After years of budget paralysis in the [[Duma of Ledostrov]], Sedava tried to mobilize peasants and march on [[Novoanov]]. The move was a direct challenge to the noble order.

== Defeat ==

The Ledostrov military remained aligned with Duma nobles. Under the [[Count of Litwaldov]], military forces defeated Sedava's untrained supporters at the [[Battle of Lisebev]]. Sedava was captured and executed for treason.

== Legacy ==

Sedava's failed revolt exposed how far the Duma system had deteriorated by the twentieth century. His execution also cleared the way for Litwaldov's short reign and the later 1942 succession crisis.
